About us

Helping homes use energy and water more wisely

Justice Energy Co. is an energy-efficiency company serving Southern California. We help homeowners understand their upgrade options, connect with programs that may apply and complete the work with care.

Request a consultation (555) 010-0199

Our approach

Clear options. Careful work. Honest guidance.

Energy upgrades can feel complicated: different equipment, different requirements and different programs. Our job is to make it clear.

We start by understanding your home and your goals. Then we explain the options that make sense, what each one involves and which programs may help. When you are ready, we complete the upgrade and make sure you know how to get the most from it.

What we value

How we work with every homeowner

Plain-language advice

We explain options without jargon so you can make a confident decision.

Right-sized solutions

Recommendations based on your home, household and goals.

Program awareness

We help you understand programs that may apply before work begins.

Careful installation

Work completed with respect for your home and your time.

Transparency

Clear expectations about scope, timing and what programs can and cannot guarantee.

Long-term thinking

Upgrades that keep saving energy and water for years to come.
